events.description: Ross Geller says Ross Geller is currently stuck in a closet with Susan Bunch and that being stuck in the closet with Susan Bunch is Susan Bunch's fault.
Ross Geller says the day Ben Geller is being born is supposed to be the greatest day of Ross Geller's life.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller's son Ben Geller is being born today.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller should be in the delivery room with Carol Willick instead of being stuck in a closet with Susan Bunch.
Ross Geller says Susan Bunch should hurry up.
Ross Geller says Susan Bunch knows that Ross Geller should be in the delivery room with Carol Willick instead of being stuck in a closet with Susan Bunch.
Susan Bunch says Carol Willick, the woman Susan Bunch loves, is having the baby Ben Geller today.
Susan Bunch says Susan Bunch loves Carol Willick.
Susan Bunch says Susan Bunch has been waiting for Carol Willick to have Ben Geller just as much as Ross Geller has.
Ross Geller says Susan Bunch should believe Ross Geller.
Ross Geller says no one has been waiting for Ben Geller's birth as much as Ross Geller has.
Ross Geller says the day of Ben Geller's birth will be over later.
Ross Geller says Susan Bunch will get to go home with Ben Geller when the day of Ben Geller's birth is over.
Ross Geller says Susan Bunch going home with Ben Geller will leave Ross Geller without his newborn son Ben Geller.
Ross Geller says the funny thing is that Susan Bunch will go home with Ben Geller.
Susan Bunch says Ross Geller gets to be Ben Geller's father.
Susan Bunch says everyone knows Ross Geller's identity as Ben Geller's father.
Susan Bunch says Susan Bunch's identity in Ben Geller's life is unclear.
Susan Bunch says there is a Mother's Day holiday.
Susan Bunch says there is a Father's Day holiday.
Susan Bunch says there is no Lesbian Lover Day.
Ross Geller says every day is Lesbian Lover Day.
Phoebe Buffay says the situation of Ross Geller and Susan Bunch arguing while Ben Geller is being born is great.
Ross Geller says he wants Phoebe Buffay to explain why she thinks the situation is great.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay means that the situation is great.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay grew up in a difficult family situation.
Phoebe Buffay says Ross Geller and Susan Bunch know about Phoebe Buffay's family background.
Phoebe Buffay says Frank Buffay Jr. left.
Phoebe Buffay says Lily Buffay died.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay's stepfather went to jail.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay barely had enough pieces of parents to make one whole parent.
Phoebe Buffay says there is this little baby Ben Geller.
Phoebe Buffay says Ben Geller has three whole parents: Ross Geller, Carol Willick, and Susan Bunch.
Phoebe Buffay says Ross Geller, Carol Willick, and Susan Bunch care about Ben Geller.
Phoebe Buffay says Ross Geller, Carol Willick, and Susan Bunch are fighting over who gets to love Ben Geller the most.
Phoebe Buffay says Ben Geller is not even born yet.
Phoebe Buffay says Ben Geller is the luckiest baby in the whole world.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is sorry.
Phoebe Buffay says Ross Geller and Susan Bunch were fighting.
